messages:
carmen_cs: Flagging OrchID.ai renewal signal. Their daily requests are down ~80% this month. No reply from their technical sponsor after the product demo.
diego_csm: thanks Carmen. any notes on why? org changes or perf issues?
nikki_ae: sales heard theyre interviewing a vendor (Skyline Labs) for a latency-focused pilot. OrchID asked for a latency benchmark last week.
ops_bot: [ALERT] OrchID.ai - Usage change: -79% (30d), Active seats: 8/60. Health score: 32/100. Report: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/orchidai/health
tony_se: I reviewed traces from their dedicated instance. Theres periodic GC stalls during peak vectorization that line up with their last spike in failures (Feb 10). Filed ENG-9123.
infra_oncall: ENG-9123 owner acked. Patch candidate is a JVM flag + better thread pinning. ETA 72h for verification.
carmen_cs: can we run a before/after bench to show Skyline comparison? want hard numbers.
nikki_ae: Jordan from OrchID requested pricing comparison too. Might be sensitivity to cost per embedding.
diego_csm: Proposed play: 1) urgent 15-min call with their interim tech lead 2) offer a targeted latenc y benchmark vs Skyline with our config 3) provide 30 days of discounted capacity to test 4) fix INF-9123 ASAP and share mitigation notes.
ops_bot: [REMINDER] Please update this thread with customer response within 48h.
tony_se: I'll prioritize the canary. If we can ship the JVM tune in 48h we can get numbers to OrchID this week.
nikki_ae: I'll ask sales to surface any cost objections and ask what Skyline demo covered.
carmen_cs: assigning: @nikki_ae outreach + price convo; @tony_se infra fix + bench; @diego_csm lead renewal play.
diego_csm: noted. drafting a 1-pager showing business impact and recommended next steps. Will post draft here for review.
nikki_ae: quick note for outreach: "Are you still moving forward with the Skyline pilot? We can run a focused latency head-to-head on your dataset and share the config and cost comparison within 72h."
infra_oncall: added a short diagnostic dump to the ticket: ```/var/log/redwood/orchidai/trace-2026-02-10.log``` includes alloc patterns.
carmen_cs: if they push back on credits, escalate to AE management for approval of a short-term POC discount. Keep me looped. :thumbsup:
diego_csm: thanks all. I'll ping OrchID now and update when I get a response.
